subject: Acme AI — payor change + term extension for upcoming renewal
messages:
From: accounts-payable@acmeai.com
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmeai.com
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: change payor entity + invoice and PO details for renewal

Hi Naomi,

We are ready to process Redwood's renewal but need to change the payor to Acme Global Holdings (new legal entity) for the upcoming term and confirm net terms. Can you send an invoice to accounts-payable@acmeai.com with the new payor name, the PO number we will reference, and a W-9 (US entity) or VAT certificate as needed?

Also, Finance is asking whether we can extend Net30 to Net45 for this renewal given timing on their side. The renewal covers the committed GPU capacity increase discussed during the renewal call.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Accounts Payable
Acme AI

Attachment: (none)

From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
To: accounts-payable@acmeai.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: change payor entity + invoice and PO details for renewal

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up and congrats again on the capacity increase.

Quick summary of what we need to close this out:
- Confirm the legal name to appear on the invoice (you mentioned Acme Global Holdings — please send exact payor line + billing address).
- Please confirm the PO number you will supply so we can reference it in our invoice.
- We can provide a Redwood W-9 (attached) and the signed renewal SOW.
- Regarding terms: our standard is Net30 for hosted renewals, but for this committed capacity upsell I can escalate to finance for a one-time Net45 for the renewal invoice. Ben is looping in for commercial confirmation.

I attached Redwood_W9.pdf and Renewal_SOW_v2.docx for your review. Once you confirm payor name + PO, Marissa from Finance will generate the invoice with the requested terms if approved.

Next steps: Emily — confirm payor line & PO. Ben / Marissa — can you confirm whether the discount and committed capacity pricing approved in the deal require any billing riders?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf (pdf), Renewal_SOW_v2.docx (docx)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-30T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: change payor entity + invoice and PO details for renewal

Naomi / Marissa —
Thanks. Confirming the commercial items: the upsell is a +40% committed GPU pool for 12 months under the existing enterprise discount. Deal economics were signed off by Sales Ops and Legal; no extra billing rider needed beyond referencing the amendment (AMEND-ACME-5123). If Finance will accept Net45 for this renewal invoice I recommend we approve it as a one-time accommodation to help their timing.

Marissa — please prepare the invoice to Acme Global Holdings with PO field blank for now; once Emily sends the PO we will insert PO and finalize. Attach the amendment reference on the invoice and include payment instructions for EFT.

Ben Carter
Account Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: accounts-payable@acmeai.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-31T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood invoice and W-9; provisional invoice for approval

Hi Emily —

Attached is a provisional invoice (Acme_PO_987654.pdf) addressed to "Acme Global Holdings" with the amendment reference AMEND-ACME-5123. Per internal approval we've provisionally set Net45 for this renewal invoice; please confirm PO number so we can add it to the final PDF and reissue if necessary.

Also attaching Redwood_W9.pdf again for your records. Payment instructions included on page 2. If EFT is preferred, let us know the correct payor remittance reference.

Attachments included: Acme_PO_987654.pdf, Redwood_W9.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Finance Manager
Redwood Inference

Note: please open the DocuSign link below to acknowledge the amendment if procurement requires a signed copy.
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/REDWOOD-ACME-987654

From: procurement@acmeai.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, accounts-payable@acmeai.com
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-01T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood invoice and W-9; provisional invoice for approval

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the provisional invoice. PO confirmed: PO-ACME-2027-778. Please add this PO to the final invoice PDF and reissue. Procurement has also signed the amendment via DocuSign (we uploaded the signed copy to your link).

One more ask: our Tax team requested a remit-to entity line that includes the EIN for Acme Global Holdings. Can you confirm the EIN will be printed on the final invoice?

Emily Park
Procurement Specialist
Acme AI

Attachment: PO-ACME-2027-778.pdf (attached to our systems)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: procurement@acmeai.com, accounts-payable@acmeai.com
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-02T14:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood invoice and W-9; provisional invoice for approval

Hi Emily / team —

Confirmed: we will reissue the final invoice with the PO (PO-ACME-2027-778) and include the remit-to line with EIN as requested. Final invoice (Acme_PO_987654_FINAL.pdf) will be sent to accounts-payable@acmeai.com by end of day.

Also confirming the invoice uses Net45 as a one-time term for this renewal, per internal approval. Thank you for returning the signed amendment — we have it in DocuSign.

If you'd like a paper copy or remittance instructions for vendor systems, tell me where to send it and we will accommodate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Finance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)
